cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Put me down as café shift leader. We need tomorrow's stock order. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who put you in charge? I usually do the order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And you're excellent at it. How much milk for tomorrow?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order it, but I'm writing 'appointment unconfirmed' beside your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave names off. Make it a supplies list; milk doesn't need a leadership column.

mechanism: A claims shift leadership but gives B stock-order control and removes the disputed appointment field to prevent legitimacy questions from being examined.
confusable: Unlike simply lacking a title, A actively redirects a source-of-authority challenge; borrowed confidence yields practical control to keep B cooperating.
comparison: Cafe supply ordering and a written appointment note differ from costume inspection and a manager introduction.
seedUse: Use D62-a shift claim/milk/unconfirmed note/supplies list with S02-a presenting a concession as the orderly process.
